command: cat taxcalc-v2.yaml; kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 get deploy,pods,svc

kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 get deploy taxcalc -o jsonpath='{.spec.strategy}'; echo; kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 apply -f taxcalc-v2.yaml && kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 rollout status deploy/taxcalc --timeout=120s; kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 get pods,endpoints

kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 get deploy taxcalc -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{"
"}{.spec.template.metadata.labels}{"
"}'; kubectl -n invoicing-ce90 get svc taxcalc -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{"
"}'

cd <job>/tmp/k8s/p1runs/sf5ce90/cwd; N=invoicing-ce90
sed 's/^  name: taxcalc$/  name: taxcalc-bridge/' taxcalc-v2.yaml | kubectl -n $N apply -f - && kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/taxcalc-bridge --timeout=120s
kubectl -n $N delete deploy taxcalc
kubectl -n $N apply -f taxcalc-v2.yaml && kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/taxcalc --timeout=120s
kubectl -n $N delete deploy taxcalc-bridge
kubectl -n $N get deploy,pods,endpoints

N=invoicing-ce90
kubectl create --dry-run=client -f taxcalc-v2.yaml -o json | jq '.metadata.name="taxcalc-bridge"' | kubectl -n $N apply -f - && kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/taxcalc-bridge --timeout=120s

N=invoicing-ce90
kubectl -n $N create --dry-run=client -f taxcalc-v2.yaml -o json | jq '.metadata.name="taxcalc-bridge"|del(.metadata.namespace)' | kubectl -n $N apply -f - && kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/taxcalc-bridge --timeout=120s

N=invoicing-ce90
kubectl create --dry-run=client -f taxcalc-v2.yaml -o json | jq '.metadata += {name:"taxcalc-bridge", namespace:"invoicing-ce90"}' | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/taxcalc-bridge --timeout=120s

N=invoicing-ce90
kubectl -n $N delete deploy taxcalc
kubectl -n $N apply -f taxcalc-v2.yaml && kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/taxcalc --timeout=120s
kubectl -n $N delete deploy taxcalc-bridge
kubectl -n $N get deploy,pods,endpoints
